title: Precious Metal Refining & Recovery, Episode 10: Platinum From the Road
summary: Cody's Lab collects a sample of dust from the side of a highway and refines it to recover platinum-group metals deposited by catalytic converters. The video walks through the chemistry of separating and assaying the precious metals.
why: HN commenters cite it as a vivid demonstration that roadside and tire/pavement dust contains recoverable platinum.

quote.text: We can literally sweep platinum off our highways, as Cody'sLab demonstrates[0].
